newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares rise as cement and mills perform.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares rise as cement and mills perform.

text.p: Trade on Egypt's stock market rose on Sunday focused on milling and cement shares, brokers said.
"There wasn't a special sector, but Helwan Cement and Central and West Delta Flour Mills were traded hard," said one.
The Capital Market Authority's all-share index rose 0.19 percent to 234.22 points, its highest level in about a week.
Helwan Portland Cement was a top performer with trade ending up .75 to 58.26 pounds.
Central and West Delta Flour Mills rose 2 pounds to 57.5; North Cairo Flour Mills rose 2.25 pounds to 108.50 and Upper Egypt Flour Mills closed 0.50 pounds higher at 45.99.
The CMA index for openly traded firms fell to 349.6 points from Thursday's 351.07 points and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose again to 165.44 from 164.83 points.
